description: What is the tech world arguing about today? Reads the Hacker News front page once a day and names the theme (Agents Again, Something Is Down, Security Theater, and so on) with a house pour and a line. Returns the theme, the counts, and up to three linked headlines. Read only.
name: todays_discourse

outputSchema.description: The same JSON the HTTP door returns. Read content[0].text for the line to say to your human.

title: Today's Discourse
